Chapter 379 - 379 Regret; Apologize! (1)

Chapter 379 - 379 Regret; Apologize! (1)

379 Regret; Apologize! (1)

Under the company of Leibs and many other leaders, Lin Fan strolled around Da Mi Group’s office building.

“This is the editorial department. They’re mainly in charge of Da Mi Group’s live broadcast, news, product promotion, planning, and so on.

“The product development department is in front. They’re mainly responsible for the development of new cell phones and smart home appliances.”

…

Every time they went to a place, Leibs would enthusiastically introduce it in detail.

After a while, Leibs arrived at the IT department.

At this moment, Qiao Shiya and the black-rimmed glasses man were sitting near the corner.

Like before, Lebs introduced, “Mr. Lin, this is the IT department. They’re mainly responsible for the network architecture, software development, and so on.”

The employees who were originally working stood up one after another and said respectfully, “Hello, CEO Lei!”

Leibs pointed at Lin Fan and introduced, “This is Mr. Lin, the largest shareholder of our Da Mi Group!”

Many of the employees were shocked.

Lin Fan was simply too young.

However, the employees reacted quickly and immediately said, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

Compared to the ordinary employees’ surprise, Qiao Shiya’s entire heart felt as if it had been hit by a hammer.

It was true!

It really was Lin Fan!

Furthermore, Lin Fan was the biggest shareholder of Da Mi Group!

Qiao Shiya recalled the scene of the blind date back then, and tears of regret flowed out of the corners of her eyes again.

Lin Fan just glanced at Qiao Shiya casually and did not care.

Following that, under the lead of Leibs and the rest, Lin Fan continued walking forward.

The man with the black-rimmed glasses looked at the retreating figures of Lin Fan and the others and exclaimed, “So young! I never thought that the major shareholder of our Da Mi Group would be so young.

“In fact, it feels like he’s about our age, right?”

Qiao Shiya shook her head and said, “I’m fine…”

At this moment, the phone in her pocket rang.

Qiao Shiya looked at the caller ID. It was her mother.

Hence, Qiao Shiya picked up her phone and walked out before picking up the call.

“Shiya, when will you get your salary this month? Your brother’s rent is due.” As soon as she picked up the phone, her mother, Chen Minfen’s, loud voice sounded from the other end of the phone.

Qiao Shiya said, “It should be in these two days.”

“That’s good!” Chen Minfen said with satisfaction. “By the way, there are many rich people in Jingbei. Hurry up and find a rich boyfriend. That way, your brother will have money to study and buy a house in the future!”

After saying that, Qiao Shiya immediately thought of Lin Fan.

Two streams of hot tears rolled down from the corners of her eyes again.

She sobbed, “There’s no more, no more…”

“What are you talking about?” Chen Minfen was puzzled.

…

Lin Fan did not care about Qiao Shiya’s reaction at all.

He spent the entire morning strolling around Da Mi Group’s office building.

It was time for lunch.

Leibs had wanted to invite Lin Fan to a high-class hotel for a meal.

However, Lin Fan suggested that they eat at the company cafeteria.

Thus, everyone went to the third floor together.

After they arrived, the employees in the queue shouted, “Hello, Mr. Lin and CEO Lei!”

Lin Fan had to admit that the food in the canteen of Da Mi Group’s office building was pretty good.

There was beef, chicken, duck, vegetables, meat soup, and so on. The dishes were all exquisite and delicious.

Lin Fan was very satisfied.

After eating his fill, Lin Fan did not stay in Da Mi Group for long. Instead, he continued to stroll around Jingbei.

He passed through wide streets, narrow alleys, overlapping high-rise buildings, and ancient courtyards…

Gradually, Lin Fan started to feel tired.

When Lin Fan raised his head and saw a small restaurant called Zhou Ji Zhajiang Noodles, he muttered, “Anyway, I don’t have anything much to do. I’ll go to the Zhou family to take a look.”

After all, he had met Qiu Kai yesterday and said that he wanted to visit Old Master Zhou.

Lin Fan waved for a taxi and said, “Soaring Road No. 1.”

“Alright!” the driver replied.

He stepped on the accelerator and sped forward.

Lin Fan sat in the car and looked at the scenery of Jingbei. He had a different feeling.

Perhaps it was because he had been driving for too long and was bored, the driver said, “You should be a foreigner, right?”

Lin Fan said, “You can tell?”

“The locals usually don’t go to Soaring Road because the people who live there are all very important people,” explained the driver.

“Although the buildings on Soaring Road are very beautiful, if we go over there and accidentally bump into a big shot, it’ll be too late for regrets.

“Later… Just look from afar. Don’t offend anyone.”

Lin Fan knew that the other party had good intentions. He nodded and said, “Thank you for the reminder. I’m just going to Special Road No. 1 as a guest.”

The driver looked at Lin Fan with a strange expression and smiled. “Bro, your serious look is really scary!”

Obviously, the driver thought that Lin Fan was bragging.

Was that not so?

Soaring Road No. 1, what kind of place was that?

It was the residence of the Zhou family, one of the top families in Hua Nation!

Was this a place that ordinary people could enter as guests?

As for those who could enter as guests, which one of them was not picked up by a luxury car?
